attorneys: Manuel Kraus and Roy J. Keefer for appellant., Thomas D. McBride, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, and Edward Friedman, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took ho part in the consideration or decision of this case.
